item.title: SQLite should have (Rust-style) editions
item.description:
📝 Other affinities have different but simpler rules: Columns with BLOB affinity store values as-is. Columns with TEXT affinity store BLOB, TEXT and NULL values as-is, but convert numeric values to TEXT. Columns with REAL affinity work like columns with INTEGER affinity except that integer values are converted to REAL.
🔗 Read more: https://mort.coffee/home/sqlite-editions/
